title: Input/output coloring and Gröbner basis for dioperads
summary: We introduce a functor $Ψ$ that associates to a dioperad $P$ acting on a vector space $V$ a two-colored operad $Ψ(P)$ acting on the pair $(V, V^*)$. The construction is based on a simple pictorial idea: by selecting one input or output and dualizing, if necessary, the remaining ones, any dioperadic tree can be ``rerooted'' as a colored operadic tree. This transformation allows one to apply the standard operadic machinery -- such as Gröbner bases and Hilbert series -- to the study of dioperads.
